storyText: As our friend or family, you probably heard a lot about our whirlwind romance so we don't need to write a novel. We met in Sri Lanka just before Christmas 2023, and after a year, 3 continents*, traveling to 9 countries so we can spend time together, we finally settled down into a very boring and uneventful life in Sydney, Australia.
storyText2: *2 Continents, if you use the correct geographic definition (Sonya)
locationIntro: Now, we are happy to announce that we're getting married, and would love you to join us and celebrate.
locationBody: To make things easier (or more complicated) for our international family and friends, we will organise two weddings: one in a beautiful village in the North East of Hungary, and one in Sydney, Australia. And you're welcome to join us for one, or both.
hungaryText: Mád village is a hidden gem in the historic wine region of Tokaj. We hope you can not just attend the wedding, but spend at least a few days with us exploring the region, tasting wine, beautiful hikes and a traditional wine harvest.
sydneyText: The Sydney wedding will be on a hill with a view, or the local bowling club. We will let you know soon.
locationNote: Join us for one — or both
thankYouTitle: Thank you for celebrating with us
thankYouText: We are so happy you'll be joining us. We'll be in touch soon with everything you need — where to stay, how to get there, and what to expect.
